reuse_rule: The same 2021-2025 BLACKBOX may be queried again only for a separately frozen identity whose model, features, clocks, gates and decision rule were fixed before that query. Reuse does not create a new independent OOS sample.
design_prohibition: BLACKBOX behavior may not be used to choose or repair features, thresholds, cutoffs, market clocks, contract-selection rules, model families, hyperparameters, regimes or successor candidates.
